Hi @eng-45, regarding SLOTPLAN-113: the design review decision for place_lunch is that when several starts are possible, pick the one closest to noon (minute 720). If two candidates are equally far from noon, take the earlier one. So with an empty calendar the break is (720, 750), not (690, 720). This is documented in my handover notes.
